asks: Keep the Sherwood Park and Strathcona-Sherwood Park boundaries largely unchanged.
Create new ridings in Calgary and Edmonton, inside the existing city limits, so urban votes count equally.
Leave Edmonton-Riverview as it is and keep historical, cultural and political communities together across the province.
Do not break up the communities of Edmonton-Manning, and align provincial ridings with municipal boundaries.
Leave Edmonton-Highlands-Norwood unchanged and do not merge Edmonton with rural areas.
Keep Edmonton-Northwest close to its current shape and do not extend it into rural areas to the north or into St. Albert.

quote: should not be used to extent the division into rural areas to the north, which are culturally and demographically very different, or into St. Albert
note: Objects to stretching Edmonton-Northwest into St. Albert; says nothing about how St. Albert and Sturgeon County are arranged, so no want and no listed option rejected.

asks: Preserve the Livingstone-Macleod boundaries as they are.
Do not blend Calgary-Shaw with rural ridings; consider dividing it into two suburban ridings with an added seat, or move communities to Calgary-Fish Creek.

quote: The largest concern I have with the redrawing of electoral boundaries, having ties to St. Albert — Morinville as well as Lethbridge West, is the recent development of allowing for the blending of larger ridings between Alberta's cities and rural areas
note: Names the St. Albert-Morinville hybrid as background to a general worry about city-rural blending; his request is about Calgary-Shaw. No want coded (rule 17).

quote: The largest concern I have with the redrawing of electoral boundaries, having ties to St. Albert — Morinville as well as Lethbridge West, is the recent development of allowing for the blending of larger ridings between Alberta's cities and rural areas
note: Lethbridge West named as background to a general worry about city-rural blending; no request about Lethbridge. A reader could see an implied rejection of L2; left blank (rule 17).

asks: Keep Calgary and Edmonton districts inside city limits, hold deviations near 10 per cent, preserve Lesser Slave Lake and Central Peace-Notley under section 15(2), give the two new seats to Calgary and Edmonton, and consider his 27-district Calgary map.

quote: the Commission should utilize section 15(2) of the Act to preserve the electoral districts of Lesser Slave Lake and Central Peace-Notley
note: Round 1; asks to keep Lesser Slave Lake under section 15(2) as the only majority-Indigenous district.

asks: Keep electoral boundaries within Edmonton's city limits.
Undo the Cardston-Siksika riding and reconfigure the Lethbridge area into three or four ridings that each join part of the city to the surrounding region.

quote: I believe that there is potential for at least three, or even four, well-connected ridings which would each include a portion of Lethbridge proper along with a sector of the surrounding region.
note: Round 1 proposal modelled on Medicine Hat: three or four ridings each joining part of the city to a sector of the region along highway corridors. Says 'at least three, or even four', so the count is not fixed at four.

asks: Make the City of Medicine Hat one electoral division, with Redcliff and Cypress County, without Brooks and the County of Newell.
Keep the four nations of Maskwacis and Pigeon Lake in Maskwacis-Wetaskiwin and adjust its north-east to match the trading area.
Put all of Beaver County, including its west end, in the Camrose riding.
Keep the Grande Prairie and Grande Prairie-Wapiti boundaries, keep several ridings in north-western Alberta, and do not enlarge Central Peace-Notley.
Tighten deviation limits, define criteria and metrics clearly, publish how public input was used, and review boundaries more often; no specific boundary request.

quote: it was discussed last night that potentially the river would be used as the electoral boundary between Lethbridge West and East, at first glance this makes sense
note: Lethbridge resident commenting on criteria. Notes Coalhurst and Coaldale are bedroom communities of Lethbridge but makes no boundary request.

asks: Fix the polling boundaries south of the Milk River in the County of Forty Mile so he need not travel seventy miles to vote.
Do not change the boundaries of Cypress-Medicine Hat or Brooks-Medicine Hat; keep two blended ridings anchored in Medicine Hat.

note: Named only as a comparison with Medicine Hat's representation (rule 6).
Named only as a comparison with Medicine Hat's representation (rule 6).
Named only as a comparison with Medicine Hat's representation (rule 6).

asks: Respect Edmonton community league boundaries, and keep wards within ridings, if provincial boundaries are redrawn.
Devise a new formula that does not rest on population alone, to protect rural and small-town representation.
Keep Calgary-Elbow whole and add new seats to reflect growth instead of dividing communities and municipalities.
Keep downtown Edmonton's boundaries in a configuration that lets its growing urban community vote together.
No boundary request; disputes earlier speakers and says Edmonton's growth will be in the core, not only the suburbs.
Add an electoral division in Edmonton, particularly in the fast-growing south-east.
Reconsider the interim boundaries in the Lethbridge region so residents just outside the city are not placed in Livingstone-Macleod, and stop diluting rural representation.

quote: I should not be expected to drive nearly an hour to meet with an MLA whose constituency office is located in a region I have no ties to, when the city that shapes every aspect of my life—Lethbridge—is represented by a different MLA altogether.
note: Lives two minutes outside the city, placed in Livingstone-Macleod by the interim map. Implies her area should be represented with Lethbridge but never states it as a request or asks for hybrid ridings as a design; coded L3 (some joining, not the four-way plan) with low confidence. A stricter reader would leave want blank.

asks: Do not let the governing party gerrymander boundaries; all parties and the public should have a say.
Do not eliminate a northern riding; keep Lesser Slave Lake much as it is, growing southward, and use the section 15 variances for northern ridings.

quote: We suggest that rather than eliminating a riding from the north, a riding like Lesser Slave can continue to exist similar to its current form, just as it has since 1909.
note: Joint letter of nine northern MLAs. Adds that the riding could grow southward to meet population.

asks: Reconsider the proposed Lacombe-Rocky Mountain House riding; keep Lacombe with the Highway 2 corridor and Rocky Mountain House in a distinct foothills riding.

quote: Keeping the Rocky Mountain House region (and its neighbouring rural/mountain-foothill communities) in a distinct riding that reflects its geographies, service-centres and challenges.
note: Writes from the Lacombe side against the interim Lacombe-Rocky Mountain House riding. Wants a distinct foothills riding for Rocky Mountain House, without naming Sundre or Clearwater County (direction). Her argument is against joining the Lacombe corridor to Rocky Mountain House at all, which is the defining feature of W2 as well as of the interim riding, so both are listed in rejects; she does not mention the division of Clearwater County.

asks: Move Cardston County and the Blood Reserve into Livingstone-Macleod and Lethbridge County into Cardston-Taber-Warner; adjust Calgary-Varsity, Calgary-Mountain View and Calgary-Klein lines; publish district areas.

quote: to move Lethbridge County to what you have named Cardston-Taber-Warner
note: About which rural riding Lethbridge County belongs in; says nothing about the city sharing a district (rule 8).

asks: Do not reduce the number of northern and rural electoral districts.
Stop the change and leave the existing seats and boundaries alone; do not remove rural seats.
Do not remove a rural riding; if anything add rural ridings.
Keep the interim distribution for the north; rejects the northern MLAs' argument for more northern seats.

quote: I sincerely hope that you stick to your guns on this, because you got it right, notwithstanding the biased argument from the northern MLAs.
note: Header: about 'Northern EDs'. Endorses the interim northern map, which dissolved Lesser Slave Lake, and rejects the northern MLAs' letter, but never names Lesser Slave Lake or Mackenzie; left without a want under rule 1. A broader reading would be K2.

asks: No specific request; objects that votes in the low-population Mackenzie riding are worth twice those in downtown Edmonton.

quote: A significant concern is exemplified by the riding of Mackenzie (Section 15(2), Lesser Slave Lake).
note: Objects to the low population of the interim Mackenzie riding as unequal to downtown Edmonton; asks for no arrangement of Lesser Slave Lake.

asks: Choose option ED24B (Okotoks-Diamond Valley) rather than Calgary-Okotoks.
Rename Calgary-West-Elbow Valley to Calgary-Elbow Valley, Edmonton-West-Enoch to Edmonton-Enoch, and Calgary-Elbow to Calgary-Altadore.

note: St. Albert-Sturgeon cited only as an example of a naming convention (rule 6).

asks: Keep Irricana out of Airdrie-East; make a rural district of Irricana, Beiseker, Acme, Crossfield and perhaps Linden, or at least pull the line west.

quote: So: keep us out. Carve a real rural strip-Irricana, beiseker, acme, Crossfield, maybe Linden-something that doesn't pretend we're just Airdrie's quiet cousin.
note: Header: Irricana; current 76 - Olds-Didsbury-Three Hills; about 51 - Airdrie-East. Wants Irricana, Beiseker and Crossfield out of Airdrie-East in a rural district; does not name Olds as the destination, hence direction. Fallback: 'at least pull the line west'.

quote: Now you're sliding us into Airdrie-East , and yeah, that stings.
note: Objects to Irricana being in Airdrie-East; says nothing about how the city itself is divided (rule 8, as worked example 11).

asks: Reconsider keeping just two fully urban seats for Lethbridge, so its MLAs reflect the region's rural ties (wording is ambiguous).

quote: we need MLA representation that reflects and strengthens that rural influence. Please reconsider your first plans by keeping just two fully urban seats for Lethbridge
note: Header: about 69 - Lethbridge-East; ticks 'Hybrid electoral divisions' and 'Rural concerns'. The last sentence is ambiguous on its face; read with the argument before it (Lethbridge needs MLAs who reflect its rural ties) it asks the commission to reconsider its plan of keeping two fully urban seats, i.e. to mix city and country. No particulars given. A second reader could take it the other way.

asks: Leave the northern boundaries as they currently are.

quote: Leave the Northern Boundaries as they currently are. Find another waay. We do not have enough voices heard inthe North.
note: Header: Widewater; current 70 - Lesser Slave Lake. Lesser Slave Lake is named only in the header; the message asks to keep the northern boundaries as they are, which keeps the riding.

asks: No explicit request; says the communities in the proposed Slave Lake-Westlock-Athabasca are too spread apart to be represented together.

quote: The priorities of these communities are too spread apart to have congruence and growth.
note: Header: Slave Lake; current 70 - Lesser Slave Lake; about 80 - Slave Lake-Westlock-Athabasca. A complaint about the interim riding that takes in Slave Lake; nothing asked for, so rejects only. The wording is vague and a stricter reader would code a bare mention.

asks: Do not add rural voters to city districts; keep districts fair and do not allow gerrymandering.
Keep Lethbridge's existing two urban districts and reject any proposal to split the city into four rural-urban districts.

quote: I urge the Commission to reject proposals that would split the city into rural-urban districts and instead uphold electoral boundaries that reflect and respect the integrity of urban Lethbridge.
note: Reacts to a 'proposal to subdivide it into four districts incorporating substantial rural regions', which was not in the interim map (the interim kept two city seats). Also: 'strong desire to maintain the existing electoral district structure'. Text closely parallels EBC-2025-2-0027 and -0037 (reworded campaign).

asks: Do not create Calgary-Okotoks; Okotoks shares interests with rural areas, not the city.
Add Springbank to Calgary-Bow and remove Wildwood, creating Calgary-Bow-Springbank bounded by the Bow River and Highway 1, Highway 22, Sarcee Trail and the Elbow River.

quote: Springbank is more connected to Calgary than Cochrane.
note: Asks to move Springbank out of the interim Cochrane-Springbank riding into Calgary-Bow. Says nothing about what district Cochrane itself should be in, so no want; note that the request would remove C1's named partner.

Appears only inside a quotation from the interim report about Conrich (rule 6).

asks: Preferably leave Okotoks in Highwood; if it must change, choose Okotoks-Diamond Valley, not Calgary-Okotoks.
Do not add the area west of Pigeon Lake to the Ponoka-Maskwacis riding; join it to the Leduc, Drayton Valley or Rimbey riding.

quote: would be better joined into the Leduc, Drayton Valley or Rimbey riding
note: Header: Winfield; current 80 - Rimbey-Rocky Mountain House-Sundre. About where the area west of Pigeon Lake belongs; nothing about Clearwater County, Rocky Mountain House or Sundre.

asks: No request; asks why constituencies are gerrymandered to favour Conservative governments.
If a change is needed, choose option B, Okotoks-Diamond Valley, not Calgary-Okotoks.
Keep the Sherwood Park riding from reaching into Edmonton inside the Henday.
Do not make Okotoks part of a Calgary riding.
Keep Lethbridge's current electoral framework of at least two city districts and reject any proposal dividing it into rural-urban ridings.

quote: I respectfully call on the Commission to reject any proposal that divides Lethbridge into rural-urban ridings and instead uphold boundaries that honor the integrity and identity of the city.
note: Reacts to a 'proposal to divide it into four districts that incorporate significant rural territories', not in the interim map. campaign: body identical to EBC-2025-2-0037 and a rewording of EBC-2025-2-0018.

asks: Do not remove Lesser Slave Lake as its own riding or merge Slave Lake with Athabasca and Westlock.

quote: I'm writing to express my sincere displeasure with the proposal to remove Lesser Slave Lake as its own riding.
note: Header: Slave Lake; about 80 - Slave Lake-Westlock-Athabasca.

asks: Do not dissolve or absorb Lesser Slave Lake into another district.

quote: to dissolve or absorb Lesser Slave Lake into another district would flout the very protections the Act was designed to uphold
note: Header: Slave Lake; about 80 - Slave Lake-Westlock-Athabasca.

asks: Put Springbank and Calgary-Bow in the same riding.
Make no changes to the Lesser Slave Lake electoral boundaries.

quote: Against changes made to the Lesser Slave Lake electoral boundaries.
note: Whole message is this one sentence (9 words). Header: Slave Lake; about 80 - Slave Lake-Westlock-Athabasca.

asks: No specific request; says her community deserves representation as much as urban citizens do.

quote: We deserve to be represented just as much as the urban citizens do.
note: Header: Slave Lake; current 70 - Lesser Slave Lake; about 80 - Slave Lake-Westlock-Athabasca. The place comes only from the header and the message asks for no arrangement.

asks: No request; fears the governing party will gerrymander.
Do not remove Slave Lake from its current riding and merge it with Athabasca and Westlock.

quote: I’m concerned about Slave Lake being removed from its current riding and merged with Athabasca and Westlock.
note: Header: Slave Lake; current 70 - Lesser Slave Lake. Objection translated to a want for the riding (rule 4).

note: Header: Slave Lake; current 70 - Lesser Slave Lake; about 80 - Slave Lake-Westlock-Athabasca. Message is only 'All the above concerns'; no stance stated.

asks: No specific request; objects that the proposal over-represents rural voters and is gerrymandering.

asks: Move Wildwood out of Calgary-Bow to an inner-city constituency and, if population is needed, extend Calgary-Bow west into Springbank.

quote: I do not agree that the riding of Lesser Slave Lake should be split in the manor proposed.
note: Closes: 'Please reconsider your proposal and leave Lesser Slake Lake riding at this time.'

asks: Stretch Lethbridge County's riding east (Taber, Forty Mile, Warner) not west, name the county in the riding, and reconsider hybrid divisions extending Lethbridge's representation into the county.

note: Reeve writing for Lethbridge County council. Asks the commission to reconsider and use hybrid divisions joining the city and the county, with no particulars. Main request is that the county's rural riding stretch east and carry the county's name.

asks: Do not give big cities more voice at the expense of northern and rural communities.

note: Header: Airdrie; current 48 - Airdrie-East; about the boundaries as a whole. Welcomes the interim proposals as an Airdrie resident (rule 5) without describing Airdrie-West and Airdrie-East.

quote: I agree with the proposals - especially regarding adding in urban areas. I also agree with the attempt to address significant growth in Airdrie.
note: Header: Airdrie; current 48 - Airdrie-East. Endorses the interim treatment of Airdrie in general terms (rule 5); no particulars.

asks: Make the City of St. Albert one complete electoral division and leave Sturgeon County as its own, instead of dividing the city.

note: Header: St Albert; current 75 - Morinville-St. Albert; about 83 - St. Albert-Sturgeon. Wants the whole city in a single district with no city-county hybrid.
